prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A polished ORIGINAL square TWO-PANEL cat comedy comic without any text. One simple horizontal divider creates two equal horizontal panels. Exactly the same fluffy white cat with soft pink ears and a tiny charcoal spot on its forehead in both. Upper panel: cat crouches on a warm wooden bathroom threshold, one front paw touching a fresh white toilet paper roll lying on floor, curious innocent face; the room tidy, gentle pastel mint background. Lower panel: same cat proudly sits with tail curled amid a spectacular but believable loose ribbon spiral of unraveled toilet paper across floor, paper nest around it, mischievous satisfied expression, a few paper curls caught in fur. Four limbs and one tail per cat, anatomically clear. High-quality handmade clay-animation-inspired 3D storybook look with subtle tactile fur, rounded shapes, pleasing soft lighting, mint and peach palette, expressive comedic storytelling readable without language. No human, no letters, no captions, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no brand, no protected characters. All crucial subjects in safe frame.

visual_qa.composition: Two panels clearly show curious white cat then playful paper mess; expressive nonverbal story
